visual_description: In the beginning of it I felt very aware that there was a screen, but about a minute or two in the screen almost split in two and then looked almost like a black hole in the middle. That went on for a bit and then later in the experiment I experienced almost a hurricane sensation where the entire room felt like it was spinning and the screen was wrapping around my head and spinning the top portion of the room. During this I also experienced seeing stars, maybe they were just white dots but it looked like I was in a whirl of space with stars all around me. The spinning spiral was tilted towards the right corner of the room, and it spun for the majority of the time that I was in the room. Then, it felt like the screen was moving towards me and the "hurricane" spinning was coming closer to my face.
emotional_experience: Somewhat unpleasant, but didn't mind going on
consciousness_changes: ["Became relaxed or sleepy","As if in a dreamlike state"]
consciousness_description: I was very aware of where I was the entire time, but it was very easy to feel like I was being "sucked" into the screen or that the screen was moving towards me.
